$comment: F-P3-01 release gate: the ONLY exported components and intent filters the release AAB of the ONE public Wayvro app may declare. Any other exported activity/service/receiver/provider, any <data> (scheme/host/path/mimeType) or BROWSABLE category in an application intent filter, or any change to the filters below fails CI. External URL schemes and app/universal links stay disabled while the decode-uri-component osv exception is open (ADR-043; CON-P3-07). `${applicationId}` is substituted by the checker. Adding an entry requires a requirement ID, a reviewed link plan and founder review.
phase: Phase 3 (P3.0): no external URL scheme, no app links; launcher entry point and the AndroidX profile installer only

exported.name: ${applicationId}.MainActivity
exported.justification: Launcher entry point. The expo-dev-client generated scheme (exp+<slug>) exists only in development builds (debug source-set manifest, apps/wayvro-mobile/plugins/dev-client-scheme.mjs).

exported.name: androidx.profileinstaller.ProfileInstallReceiver
exported.justification: AndroidX baseline-profile installer. Callable only by holders of the signature|privileged DUMP permission (adb shell / the platform), not by other apps.

$commentForegroundServices: Services allowed to declare android:foregroundServiceType in the release AAB. EMPTY in Phase 3: no foreground service (P3.5, FA-02 foreground-only Rider location; Driver online/background tracking is Phase 4 and needs its own reviewed entry with requirement IDs).
